cc:Work.dc:description: Redrawn from Stripe's engineering posts, February 9 and 19, 2026. A maximum of two CI runs is a budget, not a success guarantee. Human review is required; no automatic merge or production deployment. https://stripe.dev/blog/minions-stripes-one-shot-end-to-end-coding-agents-part-2
